flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:4101 then book a free first visit for Sam Rivera, email sam@example.com, on the second of November 2026 at noon.
Accept the waiver.
Then verify a booking confirmation with a reference code is shown and store the reference as 'ref'.
Get the booking reference code from the booking confirmation and save as {{ref}}.

verdict.root_cause: The booking form stayed on screen after the user submitted valid visit details, rather than completing the booking and displaying its confirmation.
verdict.agent_fault_assessment: The agent entered the requested date, selected noon, accepted the waiver, and clicked the labeled “Confirm my free visit” button. The screenshots show those requested values selected before submission. The failure therefore was not caused by the agent using the wrong details or omitting the waiver; the expected post-submit confirmation was absent.
